title: THE HAUL REVEAL
why: His yes to suggestion 36. After an extraction, the pictures of what you brought out, under the line that says how many items were secured, now come up one at a time on the EXTRACTED card instead of all at once. The cheapest comes first and the best lands last, a sixth of a second each and half as long again for a purple or a gold one, each with a flash and a glow in its own rarity colour and the same pick sound that rarity makes when you loot it. A HAUL line in caps counts up as they land and ends on the figure the card secured. A click on the card, ESC, ENTER or A on a controller skips it: the first press only fills the strip in, and the next press logs the run as before. A single item shows at once, and a death has no reveal. The DEMO shows no card, so nothing changes there. Nothing paid or kept changes.
now: Your haul reveals one item at a time with a rarity flash, and can be skipped.
